title: Ruins That Wake
description: Cataclysm scatters dangerous strongholds across the world. Locate a representative span of its native structures before treating their inhabitants as quarry. Questlog records discovery; Cataclysm remains responsible for the places themselves and everything inside them.
description_completed: Several of Cataclysm's major strongholds have been found and marked as targets of the reign.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
